doc.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Tape break and the name of his father's college
summary: After a break they look for a missing sheet of notes and he names Livingstone College.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: We just took a short break, and Lou found a sheet of paper with information that perhaps can supplement some of the things we’ve spoken about. What have you got?
Not what you want. This is not it
Well, you know what we can do? Perhaps we can find it and go over that material tomorrow, and interpolate that later.
yes, this is another thing here. It’s a family reunion schedule of all my people. But anyway, it was Livingstone College. That’s the name of the college that my father went to.
